title: DeepSeek-Claw skill dropped Remcos RAT through GoToMeeting DLL sideloading
summary: A skill impersonating a DeepSeek integration for OpenClaw carried hidden install instructions that an agent or a developer would run: on Windows a PowerShell one-liner fetched an MSI that dropped a signed GoToMeeting binary alongside a malicious g2m.dll, sideloading a loader that patched ETW and AMSI before decrypting Remcos RAT. The macOS and Linux instructions took a different path and installed the GhostLoader stealer instead.
severity_rationale: Full remote access trojan on Windows and a credential stealer on macOS and Linux, installed through a step the agent presents to the user as ordinary setup.
